summary_en: Kadoya Sesame Mills' board maintains its support for ITG-G Holdings' public tender offer at the originally announced price, after rejecting a revised proposal from Candidate B as not qualifying as a superior proposal under the merger agreement, and learning that Candidate A will not submit a binding proposal.
title_en: Notice Regarding Partial Amendment to "Notice of Opinion Supporting and Recommendation of Application for Public Tender Offer for Shares of the Company by ITG-G Holdings Inc."
translation_en_brief:
On November 6, 2026, Kadoya Sesame Mills announced an update to its board recommendation regarding the ongoing public tender offer by ITG-G Holdings for the company's shares. The company's special committee and board of directors have reaffirmed their support for the ITG-G tender offer at the originally announced price.

The update addresses two developments in the competing bidding process. First, the company rejected a revised proposal from Candidate B (a business company that participated in the acquisition review process) on November 2, 2026. The special committee determined that this revised proposal does not qualify as a "superior proposal" as defined in the merger agreement with ITG-G, and therefore the board cannot support it. Second, Candidate A (another business company in the review process) informed the company on November 4, 2026 that it does not intend to submit any binding proposal for the company's going-private transaction. The board has therefore ended its evaluation of Candidate A's proposal.

The company maintains its prior position supporting the ITG-G tender offer while continuing to evaluate Candidate C's proposal, which the special committee deemed a qualifying superior proposal under the merger agreement. As previously disclosed, if ITG-G does not increase its offer price to at least the level of Candidate C's proposal by October 29, 2026 (or November 9 if the tender period is extended), the company has contractual rights to withdraw its support and terminate the agreement with ITG-G. No changes have been made to the special committee's recommendation or the board's position as of this announcement.
